mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attention_item (item_id, kind, target_type, target_id, assigned_role, reason, payload, occurred_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{kind}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{assignedRole}, #{reason}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{occurredAt}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{acknowledgedBy}) -- 同じ事実は 1 行。投影を読み直しても増やさない（識別子は内容から導く）。 -- 上書きもしない。確認済み（acknowledged_at）を消してしまう。 ON CONFLICT (item_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attention_item WHERE assigned_role = #{assignedRole} AND acknowledged_at IS NULL ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
